source.note: Observed from a ThunderID 1.1.0 issuer on 27 November 2026. Header members and claim names are the observed ones. Claim values are synthetic. Signed by the corpus test key. Form requested with a resource and scope.

notes: RFC 8693 exchange, subject token the stand-in's ID token. ThunderID keeps the national subject as sub and replaces the mapped holder_ref. Every authority claim of the national token is dropped, and registry_actor_kind cannot be supplied on an exchange. The grant_type value is the RFC 8693 grant type, inferred: only the claim name was observed, not its value. The lifetime is 900 seconds, observed. aud is the exchange resource server, an absolute URI that a resource-bearing request needs. The scope claim holds the granted permission, from the connection's authorization mapping. A product whose audience is not that URI needs a configured audience line.
